units.source_text: 岛村也仰头叹了一声，仿佛自己的身体悠然飘上了银河当中。

en.t: Shimamura, too, looked up and sighed, as though his own body were drifting gently up into the Milky Way.

units.source_text: 银河的亮光显得很近，像是要把岛村托起来似的。

en.t: The brightness of the Milky Way seemed so near that it was as if it would lift Shimamura up.
Basho, who once wandered from place to place

units.source_text: ［芭蕉，即松尾芭蕉（１６４４—１６９４），日本著名俳句诗人。

en.t: [Basho refers to Matsuo Basho (1644-1694), a famous Japanese haiku poet.

units.source_text: 他一生在旅行中度过，写了许多游记和俳句］，

en.t: He spent his life traveling and wrote many travel accounts and haiku],

units.source_text: 在波涛汹涌的海上所看见的银河，也许就像这样一条明亮的大河吧。

en.t: the Milky Way he saw over the storm-tossed sea may have been just such a bright great river.

units.source_text: 茫茫的银河悬在眼前，仿佛要以它那赤裸裸的身体拥抱夜色苍茫的大地。

en.t: The vast Milky Way hung before his eyes, as though it would embrace the dim night earth with its naked body.

units.source_text: 真是美得令人惊叹不已。

en.t: It was so beautiful that it left one endlessly astonished.

units.source_text: 岛村觉得自己那小小的身影，反而从地面上映入了银河。

en.t: Shimamura felt that his own small figure was instead being reflected up from the earth into the Milky Way.

units.source_text: 缀满银河的星辰，耀光点点，清晰可见，连一朵朵光亮的云彩，看起来也像粒粒银砂子，明澈极了。

en.t: The stars studding the Milky Way shone point by point, clearly visible, and even the patches of bright cloud looked like grains of silver sand, utterly clear.

units.source_text: 而且，银河那无底的深邃，把岛村的视线吸引过去了。

en.t: And the bottomless depth of the Milky Way drew Shimamura's gaze into it.
